description: This plot, located on the right side of Figure 5, illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output values after gating, using a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8. Three distinct lines are plotted: a blue dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.003", an orange dotted line labeled "sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.126", and a green dashed line labeled "sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.080". The blue line remains near zero across all layers. The orange line starts at approximately 0.8, decreases sharply to below 0.2 by layer 10, and then exhibits minor fluctuations before stabilizing near zero. The green line follows a similar decreasing trend, starting near 0.8 and falling to approximately 0.08 by layer 20.
